governanceNotice: Per SPE Ω Directive P0-R2: Non-executed models SmolLM-135M, Gemma-2-2B, and Gemini Nano are strictly reclassified as CANDIDATE_UNTESTED with estimated quality scores labeled ESTIMATE_ONLY. No model receives QUALIFIED_PRIMARY_GENERATOR status based on hard-coded or unmeasured scores. Chrome Prompt API is verified Desktop-only (macOS/Windows/Linux) and requires initial on-demand download (~1.5–3 GB); Android/iOS is unsupported as of May 2026.

candidates.architecture: Llama-style Causal Transformer (30 layers, 9 hidden heads, RoPE, SwiGLU)

theoreticalEstimateScores.note: Unmeasured theoretical design estimate; must not be used for qualification decisions

candidates.tradeOffAnalysis: Universal cross-browser WASM CPU compatibility, manageable 78MB footprint. However, official SmolLM2 documentation reports an IFEval instruction-following score of 17.2 for SmolLM-135M-Instruct and 29.9 for SmolLM2-135M-Instruct. A 135M parameter SLM cannot be presumed to reliably satisfy complex multi-constraint instructions without empirical trial. Candidate is untested via empirical execution in this environment.

candidates.architecture: Gemma-2 Multi-Head Attention with Sliding Window & Logit Soft-Capping

theoreticalEstimateScores.note: Unmeasured theoretical design estimate; must not be used for qualification decisions

candidates.tradeOffAnalysis: High-capability local instruction following and task-specific generation. However, 1.42 GB download bandwidth and 2.4 GB VRAM ceiling make it unsuitable as default cold-start for mobile or constrained clients. Requires progressive download confirmation. Model weights not executed in this harness; empirical benchmark not conducted. Classified as CANDIDATE_UNTESTED.

candidates.modelName: Gemini Nano (Chrome Built-in AI Prompt API)
candidates.downloadSizeFormatted: On-demand component download (~1.5–3 GB on-device storage, not pre-installed on clean OS)
candidates.deviceMemoryRequiredMb: Requires >= 4 GB VRAM or modern desktop GPU/NPU, >= 22 GB free disk space
candidates.supportedPlatforms: Desktop only (Chrome 131+ on macOS, Windows, Linux). NOT supported on Android or iOS as of May 2026.

theoreticalEstimateScores.note: Unmeasured theoretical design estimate; must not be used for qualification decisions

candidates.tradeOffAnalysis: Google's official Chrome documentation confirms that the Prompt API is strictly supported on Desktop (Mac/Windows/Linux) only, and is NOT supported on Android or iOS (as of May 2026 update). It also requires substantial desktop hardware resources (minimum 4GB VRAM, 22GB disk space) and may require an initial 1.5–3 GB on-device model download via the browser component updater rather than zero download. Candidate is untested via empirical execution in this environment. Classified as CANDIDATE_UNTESTED.

candidates.modelName: SPE-Ω Core A Research Fixture (593 KB ONNX)
candidates.architecture: Causal MLP & Embedding Layer (320 token vocabulary)

empiricalScores.note: Measured on 593 KB prototype fixture; weights lack learned language competence

candidates.tradeOffAnalysis: Successfully demonstrates local in-browser WASM tensor execution, token decoding, and authentic runtime failure triggering (F02). However, weights are initialized randomly and rely on hand-configured token transitions. It does NOT possess learned language competence and cannot generate open-ended original instructions for arbitrary unseen briefs. Correctly reclassified as RESEARCH_FIXTURE_ONLY and disqualified as production language generator.

verdictNotice: Per SPE Ω Directive P0-R2, candidate models SmolLM-135M, Gemma-2-2B, and Gemini Nano are strictly reclassified as CANDIDATE_UNTESTED with scores marked ESTIMATE_ONLY. No model receives QUALIFIED_PRIMARY_GENERATOR status based on hard-coded or unmeasured scores. DUAL_CORE_QUALIFIED status is strictly withheld until real pretrained weights are integrated and qualified across executed empirical benchmarks without template fallbacks.
